title: Admin panel readability and navigation
goal: All rendered Admin panels avoid visual overlap and present clear information hierarchy at desktop and mobile sizes

in: All rendered app/admin page routes and their mounted panels, tabs, cards, tables, and dialogs
Readability, responsive layout, clear panel purpose, and direct links to detailed workspaces
Shared Admin display primitives and route-by-route visual evidence
out: API, authorization, and database contract changes
Unrelated product workflows or visual rebranding

acceptance_criteria: The dashboard tours and events panels render distinct rows and readable two-line names
Every rendered Admin route and reachable panel has a route-matrix disposition and phone, tablet, desktop, and 200% zoom evidence
Record identity, status, and actions do not overlap or disappear on narrow screens
Shared data tables retain semantic headers, keyboard-reachable links, and mobile access to essential fields
Repeated information is reduced without removing the authoritative detail or an existing action
Focused tests, lint, feature verification, Admin audit checks, and control-plane validation are recorded

progress.summary: Dashboard row collision and initial responsive collection pattern implemented; full route audit and visual verification remain open.
completed: Replaced transform-based virtual row offsets with layout offsets.
Rendered short overview lists in natural document flow with two-line names and direct links.
Added a semantic responsive Admin data table and used it for Dashboard Tours and Events.
Updated Tour and Event collection card titles and scoped Admin card overflow rules.
next_steps: Review each route and nested panel in the route matrix, repairing any overlap or repeated information found.
Capture authenticated responsive browser evidence at phone, tablet, desktop, and 200% zoom.
Run feature and Admin verification, then complete the route matrix before closing this task.
